drafted_from: tool row in tools/check-a-rendered-video/tool-rows.json, do-work/check_plan_cuts.py and test/test_plan_and_cut_speech.py (PlanCuts), which I ran with the test's tone-word stand-in speech reader
start_here: Say to your AI: "Before I render, check each cut of my plans in /work/plans against the recordings in /work/words and tell me which stretches start or end in the wrong place." It reads the tool's row and runs check_plan_cuts.py on your computer.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the plans, recordings and settings file it is given on the person's computer and writes one report file.
instructions: 1. Have a folder of plans (<slug>.json, as tool:assemble-a-plan-into-a-cut reads them) and a folder of <clip>.words.json files ({source, words}) that name each recording's media file.
2. Optionally write a settings file for plan problems (question_key, questions_file, refused_evidence, card_kind, next_prefix and so on) from your own records; leave --settings out for none.

3. The AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: tool:check-each-cut-of-my-plans-by-ear} and runs its `run` command with --plans, --words-folder and --report; a speech reader is mlx-whisper on Apple silicon or a command given with --reader.

4. Read the last line {"result": {report, plans, plan_failures, segments, to_check}}: exit 1 means a plan failure, exit 2 means only stretches to check. A stretch to check is not wrong until you listen; offer to change the plan's from or to, but change nothing yourself.

worked_examples.title: One stretch catches the next word
worked_examples.ask: Check each cut of my plan 'first' against its recording before I render.
worked_examples.given: From tools/check-a-rendered-video/test/test_plan_and_cut_speech.py (test_a_span_that_catches_the_next_word_is_to_check), which I ran. The recording take.wav says the eight words alpha to hotel, one tone each; plan first has an ask segment with no recording, a reply cutting take 0.15 to 2.45 with the text "Alpha, bravo charlie delta." and a reply cutting take 0.75 to 3.05 with the text "Bravo charlie delta.". Command: python3 tools/check-a-rendered-video/do-work/check_plan_cuts.py --plans /work/plans --words-folder /work/words --report /work/report.json (the test adds its stand-in reader with --reader). It exits 2.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"report": "/work/report.json", "plans": 1, "plan_failures": 0, "segments": 2, "to_check": ["first#2"]}} The lines above it: "first#1 take 0.15-2.45 start=ok end=ok | alpha bravo charlie delta ... alpha bravo charlie delta", "first#2 take 0.75-3.05 start=ok end=CHECK | bravo charlie delta echo ... bravo charlie delta echo" and "2 segments, 1 matched at both ends, 1 to check, 0 plan failures". The second stretch ends on "echo", a word the plan did not name.
